lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Forty zombies are leaning on the only door you have. And the steel is starting to bend.
lines.tts: [urgent, low] Forty zombies are leaning on the only door you have. And the steel is starting to bend.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: It's 3:07 a.m. You're alone on the night shift at a highway gas station.
lines.tts: [calm, low] It's three oh seven A M. You're alone on the night shift at a highway gas station.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Then the door chime rings... and whatever just walked in is not here for gas.
lines.tts: [tense, slow] Then the door chime rings... [pause] and whatever just walked in... is not here for gas.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You slam the lockdown button. Steel shutters crash down.
lines.tts: [urgent] You slam the lockdown button. Steel shutters crash down.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.tts: [quiet, ominous] Day one. Twenty-nine to go.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day seven. 4:40 a.m. A car alarm starts screaming in the parking lot.
lines.tts: [tense] Day seven. Four forty A M. A car alarm starts screaming in the parking lot.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: By sunrise, there are forty of them pressed against your shutter.
lines.tts: [slow, dread] By sunrise, there are forty of them... pressed against your shutter.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Forty bodies. Six thousand pounds of weight against one sheet of steel. The shutter bends. One bolt pops. Then another.
lines.tts: [tense, building] Forty bodies. Six thousand pounds of weight, against one sheet of steel. The shutter bends. One bolt pops. [pause] Then another.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: This is where most people make their first mistake. They panic. They make noise. They try to run.
lines.tts: [serious] This is where most people make their first mistake. They panic. They make noise. They try to run.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You do the opposite. Shoes off. Lights off. You crawl behind the counter, and you don't move. For eleven hours.
lines.tts: [whispering, intense] You do the opposite. Shoes off. Lights off. You crawl behind the counter... and you don't move. For eleven hours.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Rule of the night shift: silence is the only weapon that never runs out.
lines.tts: [firm, low] Rule of the night shift. Silence is the only weapon that never runs out.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: By nightfall they drift away, one by one. And then, on the night of Day 12, someone knocks. Not a scratch. A knock. Three times.
lines.tts: [calm, then tense] By nightfall, they drift away, one by one. [pause] And then, on the night of day twelve... someone knocks. Not a scratch. A knock. [whispering] Three times.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Who's knocking? Find out in the full thirty days, on my channel.
lines.tts: [low, intrigued] Who's knocking? Find out in the full thirty days... on my channel.
